preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (has onlyOwner access)
At least 2 minutes must have passed since the last lunaburn call (lastSync + 2 minutes)
Liquidity pool must contain LP tokens (balanceOf[pair] > 0)

exploit_hint: Call the lunaburn() function with percent_base1000=50 (maximum 5%) repeatedly every 2+ minutes. Each call transfers up to 5% of LP tokens from the liquidity pool pair to the owner's wallet. The owner can drain liquidity over time by calling this function multiple times, extracting value from the liquidity pool. Monitor lastSync timestamp and wait for the 2-minute cooldown before each subsequent call.
